nodes.title: MOSS Layout 🗺️

en.text:
## MOSS Layout 🗺️

---

@[card: Follow me](https://civitai.com/user/lonecatone23)

@[card: Follow me](https://www.instagram.com/synth.studio.models/)

@[card: Get my stuff here](https://github.com/lonecatone23)

@[card: Get my models here](https://huggingface.co/Lonecatone23)


@[card: Buy me a ☕](https://ko-fi.com/lonecatone)

### This is many hours of work. If you enjoy it, please 👍 like, 💬 comment, and feel free to ⚡ tip 😉

---


**What is it?**
- Draw boxes, MOSS puts things there. Each box gets its own description, and text boxes get spelled out (signs, titles, labels).
- People and animals go in **character** boxes, so two characters stay two different characters.
- 💡 Works with AniMOSSity and the 8-step turbo LoRA too.

---

**LC Bounding Boxes 🔲**
- Draw a box, name it, describe only what is inside it.
- **Type:** object, **character** (people, animals) or **text** (put the words in the text field).
- **Palette:** optional colours for that box only.
- ✋ Draw the background first and the foreground last.
- The canvas size here is the picture size.

**LC MOSS Layout Prompt 🗺️**
- **Prompt:** the whole picture: scene, style, light, mood. The boxes handle the rest.
- **canvas:** single = one picture, multi_panel = comic panels or a split screen, collage = a moodboard or sticker sheet.
- **width / height:** leave them at 0 (the boxes' canvas). Set them only when the node sits after an upscale.
- The Show Text under it shows what MOSS gets.

**Background picture**
- Turn it on in **Background picture on / off** to draw the boxes on a photo. The photo's size becomes the picture size.

🚀 **Speed Boost** is on (auto).

zh.text:
## MOSS Layout 🗺️

---

@[card: 关注我](https://civitai.com/user/lonecatone23)

@[card: 关注我](https://www.instagram.com/synth.studio.models/)

@[card: 在这里获取我的作品](https://github.com/lonecatone23)

@[card: 在这里获取我的模型](https://huggingface.co/Lonecatone23)


@[card: 请我喝杯 ☕](https://ko-fi.com/lonecatone)

### 这是花了很多个小时做出来的。如果你喜欢，请 👍 点赞、💬 留言，也欢迎 ⚡ 打赏 😉

---


**这是什么？**
- 画框，MOSS 就把东西放进去。每个框都有自己的描述，文字框里的字会被拼写出来（招牌、标题、标签）。
- 人和动物放进 **character** 框，这样两个角色就会保持是两个不同的角色。
- 💡 也适用于 AniMOSSity 和 8 步 turbo LoRA。

---

**LC Bounding Boxes 🔲**
- 画一个框，给它命名，只描述框里面的内容。
- **Type：** object、**character**（人、动物）或 **text**（把文字填进 text 字段）。
- **Palette：** 可选，只对该框生效的颜色。
- ✋ 先画背景，最后画前景。
- 这里的画布尺寸就是图像尺寸。

**LC MOSS Layout Prompt 🗺️**
- **Prompt：** 整张图：场景、风格、光线、氛围。其余的交给框来处理。
- **canvas：** single = 一张图，multi_panel = 漫画分格或分屏，collage = 灵感板或贴纸页。
- **width / height：** 保持 0（用框的画布）。只有当这个节点放在放大之后时才需要设置。
- 它下面的 Show Text 显示 MOSS 实际收到的内容。

**背景图片**
- 在 **Background picture on / off** 里打开它，就可以在照片上画框。照片的尺寸就成了图像尺寸。

🚀 **Speed Boost** 已开启（auto）。

nodes.title: BBOX Notes:

en.text:
**LC Bounding BBOX**
- Draw a box first 
- name it, pick a type and describe only what is inside it.
- People and animals get the **character** type so they stay separate characters.
- 🎨 color palette defines the image temperature.  
- ✋ Keep the scene prompt to the scene. Anything in a box stays out of the prompt, or MOSS locks it in.
- **block** on **if_empty** stops the run until boxes are drawn.

**Why two boxes nodes?**
- Used mainly when you want to design a stable set, then move characters. 
- Keep the set (signs, props) in one and the cast in the other. Rework the cast without touching the set.
- For panels, use one node per panel.
- 💡 Box numbers count the first node first (Neon Sign = 1, Cat = 2, Parka Girl = 3). LC Character Detailer's **in box** uses these numbers (still working on it w/ character LoRAs per box

**The image (reference only)**
- The picture on the first node is something to draw over, so you can place boxes on a real composition. It is never rendered or used as a source.
- **use image size:** the picture sets the canvas size and shape. **custom:** type your own width / height.

**canvas (LC MOSS Layout Prompt)**
- **single:** one picture. Normal scenes like this café.
- **multi_panel:** comic panels or a split screen.
- **collage:** a moodboard or sticker sheet, separate items with no shared scene.

zh.text:
**LC Bounding BBOX**
- 先画一个框 
- 给它命名，选择类型，只描述框里面的内容。
- 人物和动物使用 **character** 类型，这样它们会保持为各自独立的角色。
- 🎨 色板决定画面的色温。
- ✋ 场景提示词只写场景。框里的任何内容都不要写进提示词，否则 MOSS 会把它锁死。
- **if_empty** 设为 **block** 时，在画好框之前会停止运行。

**为什么有两个 boxes 节点？**
- 主要用于想先搭好一个稳定的场景，再移动角色的情况。
- 把场景（招牌、道具）放在一个节点里，角色放在另一个里。可以重做角色而不动场景。
- 做分镜时，每个分镜用一个节点。
- 💡 框的编号先数第一个节点（Neon Sign = 1，Cat = 2，Parka Girl = 3）。LC Character Detailer 的 **in box** 用的就是这些编号（每个框配角色 LoRA 的部分我还在完善）

**图像（仅供参考）**
- 第一个节点上的图片只是用来在上面画的，这样可以在真实构图上放框。它不会被渲染，也不会被当作素材使用。
- **use image size：** 由图片决定画布的尺寸和形状。**custom：** 自己输入 width / height。

**canvas (LC MOSS Layout Prompt)**
- **single：** 一张图。像这个咖啡馆一样的普通场景。
- **multi_panel：** 漫画分格或分屏。
- **collage：** 灵感板或贴纸页，各个元素互相独立，没有共同的场景。

steps.title: Global Prompt
steps.text: Use a global prompt (i.e  A cozy cafe by a rainy window, soft daylight, cool rainy blues and warm cafe lighting). The BBOXes all get individual prompts. ⚠️ If you say "character on the left" the character will always be on the left no matter where the BBOX is

steps.text: Save your generated image with a timestamped folder. You can rename the folder or disable notifications if you prefer. The image will be saved with a default prefix.
